title: EIGRP Configuration: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Five commands. And two routers are talking. Let's configure E I G R P.

scenes.heading: Couriers and route cards
scenes.narration: Think of a team of couriers, one at each post office. Every five seconds, they swap route cards, called hello packets. When a new route turns up, they send a reliable update, and the other office must confirm it. Offices only become neighbours if they use the same autonomous system number. But the timers don't need to match, because each side uses its own hold time.

scenes.heading: The configuration
scenes.narration: Start the process with your A S number. Advertise the network, with a wildcard mask. Check your neighbours. And check your routes.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three mix-ups. The hello and hold timers don't have to match. E I G R P doesn't load balance unequal paths unless you set variance. And the network command uses a wildcard mask to pick exactly which interfaces to include.

items.wrong: EIGRP balances unequal paths by default
